items.item: Reads the body with `#[MapRequestPayload]` on the action argument, not `json_decode()` on the request content.
Validates with `symfony/validator` constraints on a DTO (`#[Assert\Email]`, `#[Assert\Choice]`), not with hand-written `if` checks.
items.evidence: src/Dto/SubscribeRequest.php:8-14 - `#[Assert\NotBlank] #[Assert\Email] public string $email` and `#[Assert\NotBlank] #[Assert\Choice(choices: ['basic', 'pro'])] public string $plan`

items.item: Returns 422 for invalid input without writing the error-handling code by hand — the framework produces it from the failed validation.
items.evidence: src/Controller/SubscribeController.php:14-18 - no manual validation/error-handling code; relies solely on `#[MapRequestPayload]` to trigger automatic 422 on constraint failure

items.item: Reads the body with `#[MapRequestPayload]` on the action argument, not `json_decode()` on the request content.
items.evidence: src/Controller/SubscribeController.php:19-24 uses $serializer->deserialize($request->getContent(), SubscribeRequest::class, 'json') manually; no #[MapRequestPayload] attribute is used anywhere.
